# 2005–2010: The Year of Firsts and the Practice of Resilience

The first year of widowerhood is sometimes called the year of firsts—the first Christmas, the first birthday, the first anniversary of the death. But the phrase understates the experience. It is not a year of firsts; it is a year of losses compounded upon losses, each triggering the original loss, each reminder that the person who died is not coming back no matter how many times you relive the moments that proved they had existed.
